description.fallback: Naruto, Sakura, Kurenai, Yakumo and Team 8 return to Konoha, which appears to have been destroyed in their absence. They learn from the head of the Kurama clan that they are trapped in a genjutsu that has enveloped the entire town, and Naruto, Sakura, and Team 8 manage to escape with the help of Unkai. They then enter the mansion to find Kurenai and Yakumo.
